For a written permit test, KSP tells deaf or hard-of-hearing applicants to contact the testing site, make an appointment and request a sign-language interpreter. This is a KSP testing procedure, not a promise of an on-demand interpreter for every KYTC transaction.
How do I take the written permit test if I am deaf or hard of hearing?
Contact your testing site to make an appointment and request a sign language interpreter.
